verses.roman: Ara-aital ladhee yu kadhdhibu bid deen
verses.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan

verses.roman: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen
verses.translation: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

verses.telugu: కావున నమాజ్ చేసే, (ఇటువంటి) వారికి వినాశం తప్పదు!
verses.translation: So woe to those who pray

verses.telugu: ఎవరైతే తమ నమాజ్ ల పట్ల అశ్రద్ధ వహిస్తారో!
verses.translation: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]
